_: THE ONE DEFINITION OF WHAT A SPONSOR SPOT COSTS. Read by sponsor.html (the booking page), components/sponsor-apply.js (the booking form), components/loader.js (the sitewide line), components/geo-sponsor.js (the state card), each sponsor's own portal and scripts/sponsor_apply.py. scripts/test_rate_card.py fails if a price or term here is not on sponsor.html. Two spots only. Prices are MONTHLY (price_month); a year costs price_month times year_months. A State Sponsor costs price_month in most states and price_by_state where listed; a state in opens_soon is shown but not taken yet (California, Nevada and Texas, held while the state test there runs; scripts/test_rate_card.py holds this list to every active entry in data/geo-sponsors.json). Sponsors pay by check or bank wire only (Nov 13, 2026): no card payment, no payment links, no free month and no discount; the invoice we email carries the mailing address and wire instructions, and the site never shows bank details. Change a price HERE first, then run scripts/stamp_rates.py.
pay: Pay by check or bank wire. We email an invoice with the mailing address and wire instructions.
refund: Money back if you ask inside 30 days.
terms: Month to month or by the year. Cancel any time.
prepay: A year costs the same as 10 months.
review: We check each ad by hand. It goes live within one business day.

tiers.name: Sitewide Sponsor
tiers.placement: One line under the menu on every page, and one line in the AGSIST Daily email. One business at a time.

tiers.name: State Sponsor
tiers.placement: One card below the main answer on every page about that state, and for readers in that state on other pages. One business per state.

retired._: Tier ids that older records may still carry. Not sold since Nov 11, 2026: the sitewide sponsor took the Daily line, and the state card took the state and Cash Bids ribbons.
